name: orbit-thread
description: Token-efficient project setup, checkpoints and coding-session continuity.

interface.longDescription: Orbit Thread gives coding agents a small, durable continuity layer. Orbit Setup creates only missing PRODUCT, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and ROADMAP living docs, adds selective context-loading and bounded-subagent rules, and keeps local execution state separate from tracked project truth. Handoff overwrites a compact HANDOFF-STATE.md at verified checkpoints. Resume starts a fresh chat from the current handoff, read-only Git state and only the living docs needed for the task, reducing repeated context while preserving unfinished changes. Handoffs are capped at 50 lines, validated before atomic replacement, and the writer makes no network calls or Git mutations. Existing project docs and unrelated instructions are preserved.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this coding project for efficient continuity, resume a fresh coding session, or save verified current state at a meaningful checkpoint.

publication.release_notes: Orbit Thread v1.1 adds project setup, living docs, configurable subagent preferences, automatic meaningful checkpoints, fresh-context recovery and Orbit Handoff migration support.
